summary:
Read the retained execution (CheckRun 61befa27ce114c8097c8bdfa597e9ee5, status completed, exit_code 0, prerequisites matched, 4 parsed events) and turned it into a grounded conclusion, then corrected the comparison encoding. Two findings/revisions this turn, in one validated envelope (validate → valid=true):

1) Interpretation of the existing receipt — conclusion `violated`. Cited decisive parsed indices: event 1 (`control_catchup` result: snapshot_index 45 > old_last_before 25, applied 55 = leader commit 55, stalled=false, caught_up=true) and event 3 (`case_no_progress` result: snapshot_index 45 < old_last_before 222, applied frozen at 45 while leader commit 55, stalled=true, caught_up=false). With the source anchors, the follower does not converge after snapshot install because installSnapshot (raft.go:1814-1953) never truncates the suffix above req.LastLogIndex and never calls setLastLog; getLastEntry (state.go:167-174) keeps reporting the stale tail; appendEntries rejects on PrevLogEntry (raft.go:1475-1502); replicateTo (replication.go:222-260) walks nextIndex down to ErrLogNotFound and sendLatestSnapshot (replication.go:299-383) re-sends the same snapshot. Counterevidence is recorded honestly: this experiment's declared comparisons evaluated `unknown` (its two mutually exclusive `scenario_setup` admissions could not both correlate to one result event), so the conclusion rests on the cited events, not on those comparison outcomes; and the control shows the normal path does converge.

2) Successor experiment (`previous_id` set, with revision reason) that fixes the encoding: one shared `scenario_setup` admission, one shared `snapshot_catchup_result` event name, applicability selected by `stale_suffix`, and assertions on the required healthy property (`isolated_caught_up` true, `stalled` false) so the stalled case yields real violating witnesses. Harness updated and re-verified locally (native feedback only): control holds, case violated. It needs its own receipt before it can carry an interpretation.

Also added one `fact` knowledge entry tied to receipt indices [1,3], and recorded scope limits (single-process in-memory/non-monotonic store; no restart or safety claim; the predecessor's requirement wording conditioned on S>=L, which describes the control branch). Draft files: `draft/snapshot_stale_suffix_successor.json`, `draft/snapshot_suffix_harness.go`.
